messages:
noah: hey folks, doing first-week cleanup PR for the api-proxy. quick checklist Qs: preferred branch naming, max PR size, and where to put a tiny CHANGELOG blurb? also running tests locally is slow  any tips? :sweat_smile:

riley: welcome! Branches: `feature/onb-<ticket>-short-desc` or `fix/onb-...` for bugfixes. Keep PRs focused (ideally <200 LOC). CHANGELOG: add a single line in `changelogs/unreleased.md` with your GH link.

noah: got it. CI failed on `unit-tests` though, says some env var missing. How do I run unit tests like CI does?

tara: run `./dev/setup-local.sh` once (sets env and docker images). Then `pytest tests/unit -q` or `make test-unit`. If you're on mac M1, set `USE_EMULATOR=1` before running.

riley: also `tox -e py39` mirrors CI matrix. For flakey network tests use `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-k "not network"'` to skip during dev.

noah: thanks! Pre-commit flagged commit-msg length, I used the template but it still failed. Any required footers?

tara: we want `Co-authored-by:` only if pairing, and ticket reference in commit title like `ONB-456: short title`. Commit body max 72 cols. pre-commit will block but `git commit --no-verify` is allowed for WIP only (don't merge like that).

noah: who should review runtime vs api changes? CODEOWNERS lists teams but not individuals.

riley: runtime -> @tara or @infra-team, api -> @riley or @platform-team. For first PRs ask one of the listed reviewers and ping in the thread. We require one approver + one automated CI pass.

devex-bot: Tip: add the `first-time-contributor` label and `onboarding` milestone if this is your introductory PR. See /labels for standard labels.

noah: added labels and updated branch to `feature/onb-456-small-refactor`. Leaving small CHANGELOG entry. Will squash commits per the template. Thanks for the speedy help! :rocket:
